Ábrego García chooses to depart from US after previously being deported to El Salvador due to ‘administrative error’
Kilmar Ábrego García, the Salvadorian national whose mistaken deportation turned him into a symbol of Donald Trump’s mass deportation efforts, has landed in Spain.
Ábrego García arrived in Madrid on Wednesday after leaving the United States of his own volition .
“I feel free of everything evil that has followed me up until this point,” he told reporters on a video call just hours after he touched down. “I’m happy … because this time I’m leaving with my freedom, not like before when they took me out inhumanely.”
He added: “The government does not decide where my story continues. My family and I will decide our future.”
Prior to his departure, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents met him at the airport and removed his ankle monitor, according to We Are Casa, a Maryland-based advocacy group.
As he made his way through the Madrid airport, Ábrego García did not speak to reporters, instead raising his fist in the air as he climbed into a waiting van.
Ábrego García became a lightning rod in the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown in 2025 after he was deported to El Salvador in what an official later called an “administrative error”.
The 31-year-old had been living in the US since 2019, after a judge ruled that he could not be deported to El Salvador due to the dangers posed by a gang that had threatened his family. The judge allowed him to live and work in the US under ICE supervision, but he was not given residency status.
Married to an American woman, the Maryland resident was part of a group of more than 200 people sent by the US to Cecot, a notorious anti-terrorism mega-prison , in violation of the US immigration judge’s 2019 order.
Amid public outcry, he was returned to the US after a decision by the supreme court. Since then, Ábrego García has been fighting government efforts to deport him for a second time to a series of African countries proposed by Department of Homeland Security officials.
On Wednesday, his lawyer, Simon Sandoval-Moshenberg, said the Trump administration had wanted to deport Ábrego García “handcuffed, on an ICE flight bound for Liberia” on Tuesday.
“And what happened? He walked out a free man, without any restrictions, without shackles on his feet. He left for the country of his choosing, and he did so on a commercial flight, alongside everyone else,” Sandoval-Moshenberg added.
He described it as a “complete victory”, adding: “Instead of flying ICE Air, he flew United Airlines. Instead of being in shackles, he was in economy plus.”
He said Ábrego García had negotiated a deal with federal authorities in which they had agreed to allow him to leave the country, removing obstacles such as the ankle monitor and taking him off the no-fly list, as long as he left by 24 November. The Department of Homeland Security said on Tuesday Ábrego García had “self-deported” to Spain .
Sandoval-Moshenberg described Ábrego García’s departure from the US as temporary, saying that he would decide where to settle for the next two years as he waited out the remainder of the Trump administration.
“Mr Ábrego García has many options to return to the United States as the husband of a US citizen spouse and the father of a US citizen child,” he said. “We don’t expect that to happen under this administration, which we know will never give him a fair shake, but we expect that the next administration will prioritise reunifying this family and bringing him back to Maryland.”
On Wednesday, Ábrego García’s lawyer, Chris Newman, said his client had landed in Spain as a tourist and that he had no plans to meet with any politicians while in Spain. “I can confirm that he’s coming here with the intention of staying for just a few days and that he already has tickets, one could say, for his next appointment,” he told Spanish media.
His departure this week was celebrated by many who had sought to push back against the Trump administration’s pursuit of Ábrego García.
“They wanted to leave him there to rot for the rest of his life. Instead, we saw our judicial system work alongside a strong legal team to produce this outcome, where Kilmar Ábrego García is able to chart his own future,” said Senator Chris Van Hollen, the Maryland Democrat who traveled to Cecot to visit Abrego Garcia in April last year .
Van Hollen, who is vying to become Senate majority leader when Democrats regain control of Congress next year, has made Ábrego García’s case and opposition to the administration’s sweeping deportation crackdown central to his vision for the party.
“Ábrego García’s journey is an example of our constitution working despite the attacks of the Trump administration,” Van Hollen added. He said he had spoken with the Spanish ambassador to the United States, Ángeles Moreno Bau, and briefed her on “all the wrongs that have been committed by the Trump administration against Kilmar Ábrego García”, adding that he was pleased Ábrego García was now in Spain and “able to continue telling his story”.

The BBC has said it will offer more regional, digital and 10-day weather forecasts under a new partnership with the Met Office, which begins on Thursday.
The collaboration, announced last year, aims to bring together the Met Office's weather and climate intelligence with the BBC's journalism and reach, the broadcaster said.
Director general Matt Brittin said the partnership would mean "serving our audiences with the most accurate, reliable and helpful weather service we can".
But the launch comes during a savings drive at the corporation, which has seen some other weather services and bulletins dropped as part of wider cuts.
The new Met Office partnership is unrelated to the cuts and was announced last July, before the BBC embarked on its latest round of savings.
A new hourly forecast on the BBC News website and app covering 10 days, with improved medium-range forecasts
Met Office severe weather warning notifications via the BBC Weather app
More local and more digital weather reports, and more forecasts fronted by local weather presenters
More "content collaboration on BBC and Met Office channels" using Met Office expertise, and helping to explain weather and climate
There will also be Met Office branding on weather reports, and a new BBC weather centre based in the agency's headquarters in Exeter.
Brittin said the collaboration would involve "turning science into stories and helping audiences make informed decisions with our forecasts".
BBC weather bulletins will now include Met Office branding (presenter Matt Taylor pictured)
Met Office chief executive Penny Endersby said: "Today is a landmark moment as the Met Office and the BBC join forces to give even more people across the UK access to Met Office's accurate and trusted weather information."
She added: "Our new partnership with the BBC combines the Met Office's world-leading science with the BBC's incredible reach, giving a powerful opportunity to bring the story of our changing weather and climate to millions more people."
A previous partnership between the BBC and the Met Office ended in 2018.
Since 2018, the BBC's data for its weather forecasts has been provided by the Dutch MeteoGroup, which was later acquired by US weather services company DTN.
Separately, the BBC has dropped or shortened a number of national television and radio weather bulletins in recent weeks, as the corporation continues to work towards a £500m savings target.
Some weekend and late-night forecasts have been dropped from the TV schedules, with regional presenters instead now delivering a UK-wide weather outlook during their presenting slots.
Listeners have also complained about programmes such as Radio 4's PM no longer delivering a full weather bulletin, with presenter Evan Davis instead reading a short summary and directing listeners to the BBC website for a more detailed forecast.
The BBC said it was changing its weather team to better serve digital platforms, in line with audience research and changing consumption habits.
The corporation said more users are accessing weather information via the BBC's app, website and social platforms, as the number of people relying on broadcast bulletins declines.
A spokesman for the corporation said: "The BBC is committed to providing a world-class public service for weather forecasting and information across our platforms.
"As we announced in July, we are making changes to the way we deliver weather information as more people are turning to mobile and the website for their weather forecasts. We also recognise that people want more local forecasts, along with the national picture, to help them plan their coming days more accurately.
"As such we are providing more digital and localised forecasts, as well as ensuring we still have appropriate national weather bulletins across the TV and radio."
BBC Radio 4's Today programme, BBC Breakfast and the weekday editions of BBC One's News at Six will retain their usual national weather forecasts.
Next round of BBC cuts will be more noticeable to audiences, report warns

Jamie Carragher felt Man Utd were 'unlucky' to be controversially denied two goals by refereeing decisions and said Mauricio Pochettino will feel like his side were 'robbed' of what would have been a 'really big win'
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Jamie Carragher says Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens' confidence is a cause for concern after his howler cost Mauricio Pochettino a first win since taking charge.
It was a nightmare performance for Lammens, who unnecessarily gave away the penalty for Luis Suarez's opener just 75 seconds after saving the Sporting striker's poorly taken first spot-kick.
Lammens, 24, then spilled a routine cross late in the second half which allowed Suarez to equalise for 2-2, denying United a first away win of the season and first away Champions League win for five years.
The Belgium international, signed from Club Brugge last summer, restored calm between the sticks last season after Andre Onana's calamitous spell as No 1, but has had a poor start to his second season at Old Trafford.
Delivering his verdict on Lammens' performance, Carragher said on CBS : "You worry about the confidence of that goalkeeper now.
"That mistake for the equaliser, the 2-2 goal, you say sometimes 'an amateur goalkeeper wouldn't make that mistake'. If that was an amateur goalkeeper you'd be thinking 'that can't happen'. That just can't happen at this level."
Carragher questioned if United had the options in their goalkeeper department to bring Lammens out of the spotlight for a brief while.
Pochettino could call on Karl Darlow if he wanted to make a change at goalkeeper. He was signed in the summer on a free transfer from Leeds, where he was the No 1 for the second half of last season.
"It is getting to the stage with the goalkeeper now," Carragher added. "The focus on a Man Utd goalkeeper is always big if he's making mistakes. I don't think the back-up's even at the level where, no matter how poorly the goalkeeper plays, you change it."
Carragher felt United were "unlucky" to see two goals controversially ruled out but criticised the players for allowing games to spiral out of control when they suffer set-backs.
The Sky Sports pundit said it must frustrate Pochettino but will make for an "unbelievable" watch when the fly-on-the-wall documentary being filmed this season is released.
"Why do they keep shooting themselves in the foot?" said Carragher. "As a manager, what can he really do about the goalkeeper or Tielemans making a stupid tackle at the end?
"He'll be really frustrated because that could have been a really big result for them tonight at 2-1, and there were unlucky with the 3-2 [goal being disallowed].
"He will feel they've been robbed by the referee and he'll say they should have won the game.
"But he'll be looking at isolated incidents and it feels like every game is mad. There's never a normal game where you win 1-0 or you draw 1-1 and nothing really happens. Something happens all the time that you're almost laughing at, or you've got your head in your hands if you're a Man Utd fan.
"There is always madness or craziness. I mean, the documentary is going to be unbelievable isn't it."
The last thing Pochettino needed after the 4-0 defeat at Liverpool - and Leny Yoro's now overturned red card - was more refereeing controversy. However, there was contention around both goals United had ruled out in Lisbon.
Amad had the ball in the back of the net toward the end of the first half to equalise - but not before the whistle had gone for what was judged to have been a foul by Tielemans, who clearly won the ball with his slide tackle.
The United midfielder received a booking for his follow through on Sporting defender Inacio, who went down dramatically despite receiving the slightest of contact. VAR could not intervene as the whistle had gone.
Morrison, who said Tielemans "won the ball", was adamant that it was the wrong call.
United's second disallowed goal, which was ruled out following VAR intervention, saw Dorgu penalised for making contact with Sporting goalkeeper Kaique before he punched into his own net.
Carragher felt it was "very harsh" for the referee to disallow the goal after being sent to his monitor.

Samsun 'da 91 yaşındaki emekli İngilizce öğretmeni Recep Öztürk, yıllar önce satın aldığı taşlı ve kıraç araziyi binlerce ağacın yükseldiği bir orman parkına dönüştürdü.
Öztürk, İhlas Haber Ajansı'na (İHA) verdiği röportajda araziye ilk geldiğinde orada 'kalem kadar bir bitki' bile olmadığını anlattı. Ona göre dönüşümün anahtarı, 155 metre derinlikte bulunan suydu. Yüzüncü Yıl Atatürk Botanik Ormanı adını verdiği parkı ise belediyeye devretti.
Öztürk'ün hikâyesi aslında yeni değil. Anadolu Ajansı'nın 2019'daki haberine göre Öztürk, 1996'da Samsun 'un Atakum ilçesinde yaklaşık 10 dönümlük bir arazi satın aldı. Arazi o dönem taşlı, dikenli ve kıraçtı.
İHA'ya konuşan Öztürk, en büyük sorunun su olduğunu anlattı. Araziye sondaj vurdurduğunu, 155 metre derinlikte iyi bir suya ulaştığını söyledi: 'Burası, gördüğünüz bu yeşillik, o suyun ürünü. Bu su olmasaydı kesinlikle burada böyle cennet gibi bir yer yapamazdık.'
91 yaşındaki öğretmen , bu çalışmayı hayatındaki 'son mücadele' olarak tanımlıyor.
Öztürk, 2019'da Milli Mücadele'nin 100. yılı dolayısıyla arazisini Atatürk Botanik Orman Parkı adıyla halka açmıştı. AA'nın o yılki haberine göre alanda 150 türde 4 binin üzerinde ağaç ve bitki vardı; Öztürk o güne kadar yaklaşık 150 bin fidan bağışladığını da söylemişti.
Parktaki en dikkat çekici ayrıntılardan biri palmiyeler. Öztürk, İHA'ya '19 Mayıs 1919 tarihini bu tüylü palmiyelerle toprağa diktim' dedi.
2019'da alanı devlete bağışlamayı planladığını söyleyen Öztürk, bugün parkı belediyeye devretmiş durumda: 'Ben sadece onlara yardımcı olabilirim.'
AA'ya göre Bulgaristan 'daki Rodop Dağları'nın eteğinde, bir Türk köyünde doğan Öztürk, 14 yaşında ailesiyle Türkiye'ye göç etti. 1958'de İstanbul Öğretmen Okulu'ndan mezun oldu, birkaç yıl sonra İngilizce öğretmeni olarak Samsun 'a atandı.
Öztürk, öğretmenliği hem devlet okullarında hem de özel okullarda yaptığını anlatıyor. Meslekteyken burs kazanıp ABD 'deki Teksas Üniversitesi'ne gittiğini, orada hem İngilizce hem Rusça çalıştığını söylüyor.
Eski öğrencilerinden bahsederken de gururunu saklamıyor: Öztürk'e göre bugün üniversitelerde 35-40 profesör öğrencisi var.
Öztürk'ü 24 Kasım Öğretmenler Günü dolayısıyla Samsun İl Milli Eğitim Müdür Yardımcısı Neşe Özşay ziyaret etti.
Ziyarette doğayı korumanın önemine değinen Öztürk, gençlerin ormanı gezmesini istediğini söyledi. Fatih Sultan Mehmet'e atfedilen 'Ormanımda bir dalı kesenin başını keserim' sözünü hatırlatarak, 'Ecdadımızın doğaya ne kadar önem verdiğini genç nesil gelip görsün istiyorum' dedi.

Türkiye'nin ilk astronotu Alper Gezeravcı, Ay Araştırma Programı için yeni takvimi paylaştı. Gezeravcı'nın verdiği bilgiye göre Türkiye, 2027 yılının ikinci çeyreğinde Ay'a ulaşmayı hedefliyor. Görev başarıya ulaşırsa Türkiye, 1966'dan bu yana Ay yüzeyine ulaşabilen yalnızca 5 ülkenin ardından listeye giren altıncı ülke olacak.
Türkiye Uzay Ajansı Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi Tuğgeneral Alper Gezeravcı, Sivas Cumhuriyet Üniversitesi'nin düzenlediği 'Sektör Kampüste Kariyer Buluşmaları' programına konuk oldu. 100'üncü Yıl Kültür Merkezi'nde öğrenci ve akademisyenlerle buluşan Gezeravcı, uzay yolculuğu sırasında yaşadıklarını anlattı, Türkiye'nin uzaydaki hedefleri ve süren projeler hakkında bilgi verdi.
Milli Uzay Programı'nın en dikkat çeken başlıklarından Ay Araştırma Programı'na da değinen Gezeravcı, görevin iki aşamada ilerleyeceğini söyledi. İlk aşamada Ay yüzeyinde önceden belirlenen bir noktaya sert iniş yapılacak. İkinci aşamada ise bilimsel çalışmalar yürütecek 'rover' adlı keşif aracı, yumuşak iniş yöntemiyle Ay'a indirilecek.
Gezeravcı, amacın yalnızca Ay'ın çevresinde tur atmak ya da yörüngeye girmek olmadığının altını çizdi. Türkiye'nin hedefinin doğrudan Ay yüzeyine ulaşmak olduğunu vurguladı.
Gezeravcı'nın aktardığına göre Ay yüzeyine ulaşma başarısını 1966'dan bu yana yalnızca beş ülke gösterebildi. Bu listede bugüne kadar Sovyetler Birliği, ABD , Çin , Hindistan ve Japonya yer alıyor. Türkiye, 2027'deki görevle bu ülkelerin ardından altıncı sıraya yerleşmeyi amaçlıyor.
Programın teknik tarafında da önemli bir eşik geride kaldı. Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanı Mehmet Fatih Kacır, eylül ayında Ay görevi için geliştirilen uzay aracının üretim, montaj ve entegrasyonunun tamamlandığını duyurmuştu. Yaklaşık 3,5 ton ağırlığındaki araç, sistem seviyesindeki çevre testleri için TUSAŞ'a gönderilmişti.
Gezeravcı, konuşmasında uzaya erişimde dışa bağımlılığın azaltılması gerektiğine de dikkat çekti. Fırlatma planlarında uzun bekleme süreleri yaşandığını hatırlatan Gezeravcı, hedeflerin kimsenin iznine bağlı kalmadan, Türkiye'nin kendi belirlediği takvimle yürütülebilmesi için 'uzaya erişimimizin bağımsız olması gerekiyor' dedi.
Programın sonunda gençlere seslenen Gezeravcı, Türkiye'nin geçmişten bugüne çok sayıda başarı hikayesi yazdığını söyledi. Öğrencilerden bu başarıları görmelerini ve kendi potansiyellerine güvenmelerini isteyen Gezeravcı, önyargıların özgüvenin önüne geçmemesi gerektiğini ifade etti. Milli Uzay Programı kapsamındaki çalışmaların belirlenen takvime göre sürdüğünü de sözlerine ekledi.

Bana çalmak için 25 yılını harcadılar.” dediğini söyledi. İkilinin temsilcileri çarşamba günü yaptıkları ortak açıklamada, "Ailemizin yararını gözeterek mahkeme dışında anlaştık, başka bir yorum yapmayacağız." ifadelerini kullandı.

Jolie ile Pitt, şato ve bağların çoğunluk hissesini 2008'de satın aldı. Altı yıl sonra burada evlenen çiftin ayrılık süreci, Jolie'nin 2016'da boşanma davası açmasıyla başladı.
Pitt, açtığı davada Jolie'nin şato ve bağdaki payını kendisinden izin almadan sattığını öne sürdü. İkisinin, diğerinin onayı olmadan hisselerini satmamak üzere anlaştığını savundu. İddiaya göre Jolie, payını Rus oligark Yuri Şefler'in denetimindeki Lüksemburg merkezli bir içki şirketine devretti.

Polisin soruşturduğu olayla ilgili Pitt hakkında suçlama yöneltilmedi. Pitt, iddiaları başından beri reddediyor.

Türkiye Uzay Ajansı Yönetim Kurulu Üyesi ve uzaya çıkan ilk Türk astronot Tuğgeneral Alper Gezeravcı, Sivas Cumhuriyet Üniversitesi’nde düzenlenen programda Türkiye’nin Milli Uzay Programı kapsamında yürüttüğü çalışmalara ilişkin önemli açıklamalarda bulundu.
Sivas Cumhuriyet Üniversitesi (SCÜ) tarafından düzenlenen 'Sektör Kampüste Kariyer Buluşmaları' programına katılan Gezeravcı, 100'üncü Yıl Kültür Merkezi'nde öğrenciler ve akademisyenlerle bir araya geldi. Uzay yolculuğuna ilişkin deneyimlerini paylaşan Gezeravcı, Türkiye'nin uzaydaki hedefleri ve devam eden projeleri hakkında bilgi verdi.
Milli Uzay Programı'nın önemli başlıklarından biri olan Ay Araştırma Programı'na değinen Gezeravcı, Türkiye'nin 2027 yılının ikinci çeyreğinde Ay'a ulaşmayı hedeflediğini belirtti.
Planlanan görevin iki aşamadan oluşacağını aktaran Gezeravcı, ilk aşamada Ay yüzeyinde belirlenen bir noktaya sert iniş yapılmasının hedeflendiğini söyledi. İkinci aşamada ise bilimsel çalışmalar gerçekleştirecek rover adı verilen uzay keşif aracının Ay yüzeyine yumuşak iniş yapmasının planlandığını ifade etti.
Gezeravcı, söz konusu hedefin yalnızca Ay çevresinde tur atmak veya yörüngeye girmekten ibaret olmadığının altını çizerek, doğrudan Ay yüzeyine ulaşmayı amaçladıklarını vurguladı.
Ay yüzeyine ulaşma hedefinin önemine dikkat çeken Gezeravcı, 1966 yılından bu yana bu başarıyı yalnızca beş ülkenin elde edebildiğini belirtti. Türkiye'nin de bu ülkelerin ardından altıncı sırada yer almayı hedeflediğini kaydetti.
Türkiye'nin uzay çalışmalarında kendi belirlediği takvim doğrultusunda ilerleyebilmesi için bağımsız uzay erişiminin önem taşıdığını dile getiren Gezeravcı, fırlatma planlamalarında uzun bekleme süreleri yaşandığına dikkat çekti.
Gezeravcı, uzaya erişim konusunda dışa bağımlılığın azaltılması gerektiğini belirterek, "Bizim uzaya ilişkin koymuş olduğumuz hedefleri kimsenin iznine tabi olmaksızın, belirlediğimiz takvimler doğrultusunda planladığımız şekilde icra edebilmemiz için uzaya erişimimizin bağımsız olması gerekiyor" dedi.
Programda gençlere de seslenen Gezeravcı, Türkiye'nin geçmişten bugüne pek çok başarı hikayesine imza attığını ifade etti. Gençlerin bu başarıları görmesi ve kendi potansiyellerine güvenmesi gerektiğini belirten Gezeravcı, önyargıların özgüvenin önüne geçmesine izin verilmemesi çağrısında bulundu.
Türkiye'nin uzay alanındaki hedeflerinin bağımsızlık vizyonuyla birlikte ilerlediğini vurgulayan Gezeravcı, Milli Uzay Programı kapsamında belirlenen takvim doğrultusunda çalışmaların sürdüğünü aktardı.

The BBC has lodged an "urgent" appeal against a US judge's decision to allow Donald Trump's $10bn (£7.6bn) lawsuit against the corporation to go ahead.
The US president is suing the BBC for defamation over the way an episode of Panorama edited a speech he gave in January 2021, shortly before the riot at the US Capitol.
Earlier this month, a federal judge in Florida ruled that the defamation case could proceed after the BBC sought to dismiss it.
The BBC has now filed an appeal with a higher court, saying there is a "complete lack of evidence" that anyone in Florida accessed the programme, and that the broadcaster made "rigorous and systematic efforts to prevent access to the documentary" in the US.
A BBC spokesman said: "We are surprised and disappointed by the court's decision that this case should be heard in Florida.
"As we have made clear from the start, the BBC broadcast this documentary in the UK - and UK only. We did not show it in Florida, nor did any other broadcaster.
"Given the urgency of this issue, we are now requesting a higher court review the ruling."
President Trump's lawsuit accuses the BBC of "intentionally, maliciously and deceptively doctoring" the speech he gave on 6 January 2021.
The BBC has apologised for the edit in Trump: A Second Chance, which it said had given "the mistaken impression that President Trump made a direct call for violent action".
But the corporation argued that the Panorama episode, which was broadcast in 2024, did not meet the legal criteria for defamation.
Earlier this month, federal judge Jeffrey T Kuntz found Trump's defamation allegations against the BBC sufficient for the case to continue, although he did not rule on the merits of the case.
President Trump called the judge's ruling a "huge victory" in a post on Truth Social at the time.
The BBC has now lodged an appeal with the US Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit, arguing that the Florida court has no jurisdiction to hear the case.
Trump has been ordered to answer questions under oath as part of the lawsuit by 22 January.
Judge Kuntz has scheduled a trial date for the case for 3 May 2027 in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
Judge allows Trump's $10bn defamation case against BBC to proceed

This sculpture called 'Let the Dance Begin' greets motorists as they drive into Strabane
A competition that is supposed to celebrate local towns has been rejected by a council after it caused "great division" over its UK title.
The mainly-nationalist town of Strabane in County Tyrone was shortlisted as one of 15 possible locations for the inaugural UK Town of Culture 2028, with the chance to win £3m.
However, the local council voted not to go ahead with the bid on Wednesday with one councillor claiming it "has the potential to be a disaster for Strabane - for community relations".
The motion, which was put forward by independent councillors, was backed by the Social Democratic and Labour Party (SDLP) and Sinn Féin.
A report prepared for councillors said that money had come from a £60,000 Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS) grant, and would need to be repaid if the bid did not make it to the final submission stage.
Independent Paul Gallagher, who had previously expressed concerns about the town's entry in the competition, said it had "caused great division in Strabane town".
He said there was widespread concerns about the competition's UK title.
"If it was to go forward it would create a major distrust in this council among the residents of Strabane," said Gallagher.
Strabane, he said, would become "a very uncomfortable place" if the bid was progressed, adding there was the potential for protests in the town.
Independent councillor Paul Gallagher put forward the motion
The overall Town of Culture winner UK Town of Culture 2028 will receive £3m to develop a year-long programme of cultural celebrations while the other two finalists will each receive £250,000.
Unionists on Derry City and Strabane District Council said it was disappointing the bid was not being progressed to a final submission stage.
There is a deadline of 30 November for final bid submissions.
Sinn Féin councillor Brian Harte said they were backing the motion after "consulting with and listening to representations from many people within the local community".
"We must acknowledge that the UK branding of this competition has prevented a large section of the local community and key groups from identifying with or participating in the bid," he said.
He said the debate around the branding had "become toxic in recent months", adding council officials working on the bid had been subjected some abuse, particularly online.
Ulster Unionist councillor Derek Hussey says Strabane is missing out by not progressing with the bid
SDLP councillor Catherine McDaid said local concerns "need to be taken seriously".
"A cultural initiative should bring people together," she said.
"The priority now has to be to work on what has already been completed and looking into fresh opportunities for Strabane, shaped by what local people want and need, and grounded in their support," she said.
Ulster Unionist councillor Derek Hussey said it was "remiss" not to pursue with the bid.
Strabane and its people, he said, were being denied a similar opportunity to that of Derry which was the inaugural UK City of Culture in 2013.
Staying in the competition, he said, could "only be to the social and economic wellbeing of residents, business and visitors, long term as has been proved previously with the city's experience of having had the title of UK City of Culture," he said.
The Democratic Unionist Party's Keith Kerrigan said it was disappointing that at a time of wider investment in Strabane, the potential of a further £3m was being taken away.
"It is disappointing but we can see which way this vote is going to go," he said.
The council motion not to submit a final bid submission, included an amendment that council would work towards developing it s own cultural programme for the County Tyrone town in 2028.
The motion to not progress with the bid was first put forward last week at a council committee and was deferred until Wednesday's meeting.
At that time, councillors were told following two public engagement sessions in the town in early November, a total of 146 feedback forms were returned to council, six of which were supportive of the bid.

Kitap dünyasına açılan kapınızı aralayın! En sevdiğiniz kitapları indirimli fiyatlarla keşfedin ve hayal gücünüzü genişletin.
UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nin 5. haftasında Lille , ilk yarısını geride kapattığı maçta Bayern Münih 'i 2-1 mağlup etti.
Berke Özer 'in kalesini koruduğu Fransız ekibi, ikinci yarıda üç dakika arayla gelen gollerle lig aşamasındaki ilk galibiyetini aldı.
Pierre-Mauroy Stadı'nda oynanan karşılaşmanın 15. dakikasında Tom Bischof'un kullandığı kornerde Dayot Upamecano, yakın mesafeden kafa vuruşuyla Bayern'i öne geçirdi. Lille, 23. dakikada Ayase Ueda ile beraberliğe yaklaştı ancak Jonas Urbig gole izin vermedi.
Berke Özer de 26. dakikada Konrad Laimer'in, bir dakika sonra Aleksandar Pavlovic'in şutunu çıkardı. Bayern Münih devre arasına 1-0 önde girdi.
İkinci yarının başında Lille'in Ueda ile bulduğu gol, VAR incelemesinin ardından faul gerekçesiyle iptal edildi. Japon golcü, 62. dakikada ceza sahasında kontrol ettiği topu uzak köşeye göndererek skoru 1-1'e getirdi.
Üç dakika sonra hızlı atağa çıkan Lille'de Ethan Mbappé'nin vuruşu direkten döndü. Seken topa müdahale eden Pavlovic , meşin yuvarlağı kendi ağlarına gönderdi ve Lille 2-1 öne geçti.

Bayern Münih ise 28 Kasım'da Bundesliga'da Hamburg deplasmanına gidecek ve 8 Aralık'ta Şampiyonlar Ligi'nde Slavia Prag'ı ağırlayacak.

TV chef Gordon Ramsay is to lead the new presenting line-up on BBC motoring show Top Gear, which is being revived four years after it was last on air.
Ramsay will take the driving seat alongside as yet unnamed co-presenters when the show starts filming next year. It will return to screens in 2028.
The long-running programme has been off air since 2022, when co-host Andrew Flintoff suffered serious facial and rib injuries after his open-topped three-wheeled car overturned at the show's test-track.
In a statement announcing his new role, Ramsay said he wants to bring "a fresh energy and ambition" to the show's formula of being "surprising, entertaining and [with] just the right amount of chaos".
Andrew Flintoff, Paddy McGuinness and Chris Harris hosted the show before it was rested
Top Gear began in 1977 and became one of the BBC's biggest hits in the hands of Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May in the 2000s.
They were replaced by hosts including Chris Evans and Friends star Matt LeBlanc, before Flintoff took over in 2018 with Paddy McGuinness and Chris Harris.
But the show was "rested" after the former cricketer's crash in December 2022.
Flintoff was dragged face-down underneath the Morgan Super 3 car for about 50 metres. "I thought I was dead," he told a Disney+ documentary last year.
The BBC apologised and paid compensation to Flintoff following his crash.
In Wednesday's statement, Ramsay said he has had a love of cars since he grew up near the Silverstone race circuit in Northamptonshire.
"I would climb over the fences and sneak in for a glimpse of the racing," he said. "That early excitement sparked a lifelong passion for cars, motor sport, beautiful design and extraordinary engineering.
"At its very best Top Gear has always been about the unexpected - surprising, entertaining and just the right amount of chaos.
"That's the spirit we want to build on, bringing a fresh energy and ambition to create something truly thrilling for a whole new generation of audiences.
"It's an incredibly exciting opportunity, and I genuinely can't wait to get started!"
Former host Richard Hammond told BBC Radio 4's PM programme that Top Gear is "a grand old BBC stalwart".
"It goes back decades. We had our tenure of it and did our thing with it and went a bit crazy with it, and it'll be another incarnation of it," he said. "And great. It's a long runner, it'll carry on."
He said that he does not doubt Ramsay's credentials as a car fan, and joked that TV chefs "love three things: cooking - well in his case four - swearing, cooking, but also big watches and cars".
Hammond was seriously injured in a crash while filming the show in 2006, but said it "doesn't have to be" a dangerous show.
The BBC asked Hammond to return to the show for the new series, he said.
"They did talk to me about it. They came to me about maybe getting involved in leading the new Top Gear, and I don't want to drag it back to what it was. That's why I didn't do it," he said.
Ramsay drove in a celebrity race in Lego-themed cars at the Las Vegas Grand Prix at the weekend
Ramsay, 60, owns an extensive collection of cars including multiple Aston Martins and Ferraris, as well as a Porsche, Land Rover and McLaren Senna.
He has also appeared on Top Gear three times as a guest - in 2002, 2006 and 2017.
The BBC's director of entertainment Ed Havard said: "Gordon's fierce and fearless approach makes him a natural fit, and we're thrilled that audiences will see him in the driving seat as the show speeds into its next exciting era."
Suzy Lamb, managing director for BBC Studios Entertainment, added: "The return of Top Gear had to feel like a real TV event and Gordon fits the bill perfectly.
"He brings passion, mischief, genuine motoring credibility, and the kind of infectious competitive streak that defines the show at its best."
She promised that it "won't be a nostalgic reboot" but will be a "bold and unmissable new chapter for the most entertaining motoring show in the world".
Comedian Jimmy Carr was rumoured to have been in talks to join the hosting line-up, but was reported on Tuesday , external to have "pulled out".
Top Gear is the second high-profile show involving Ramsay to have been announced in the past week.
He has also been confirmed to star in a revival of Hell's Kitchen on ITV, hosted by Claudia Winkleman, more than two decades after he originally appeared on the celebrity cooking programme.

Late-night hosts discussed dysfunction in the US while also revisiting the ongoing Nvidia scandal
Late-night hosts continued to express confusion over the handling of the Nvidia scandal while looking at the many other problems created by the Trump administration.
On Jimmy Kimmel Live! the host spoke about the annual Thanksgiving turkey pardoning, which used to be ridiculed as something silly for presidents to be doing but for Trump, “now it’s the most normal thing he does”.
Kimmel joked that the turkeys will be sent to the “same farm they will be sending Mitch McConnell to in January”.
This week also saw the president award the Presidential Medal of Freedom to the disgraced former New York mayor Rudy Giuliani. It’s the “highest civilian honour” and meant that Giuliani had to endure an “hourlong speech from the president about his helipad”.
After Jensen Huang was reinstated at Nvidia, he informed the board about additional affairs. “This guy was a real Don Huang,” Kimmel quipped.
He has promised to “keep his microchip in his shorts from now on” but Kimmel added that “the fact that this man is not being investigated by our government is crazy”.
Trump also made $15m on Nvidia shares, which Kimmel said would have been a corruption scandal for any other president but it was “not even the top craziest thing he’s done this week” as he has “a gift for grift”.
He also hosted “the most exclusive dinner in the world” for those who have invested in his memecoin, including Tristan Thompson and Kevin O’Leary.
Yet the value has dropped 98%, “more than his testicles even” and Kimmel noted that even with everything that is happening, he “still finds time to run a pyramid scheme out of his golf course”.
The week has seen more flight delays and problems after planes were grounded on the 13th which the government said was not the result of the cyber-attack and “you can take that to the bank if your bank ever comes back online”.
The CIA was also hacked this week and even though the issue has been resolved with no apparent problem, “if a burglar broke into your house but didn’t take anything you’d still be worried, right?”
He joked that “ever since Trump took over, America is running like the security system at Jurassic Park”.
On Late Night, Seth Meyers also covered the Presidential Medal of Freedom being given to Rudy Giuliani. “Before this news broke I was certain he was dead and now i’m only 95% sure he’s dead,” he joked.
He moved on to the Nvidia scandal and said that “every day this mess gets worse” with news of the additional affairs and Trump’s bizarre AI-generated social media post with Huang holding a bra.
“Posting a meme is a good sign you’re not taking national security seriously,” he said.
Meyers remarked that Nvidia was crucial to keeping the AI bubble alive yet “people absolutely hate it” with the recent midterm elections showing that the majority of voters decided to reject datacentres.
“We’ve entered a very weird new economic world where the wealthiest and most powerful companies are building a product that Americans don’t seem to want,” he said.
He remarked on the “awful conditions” that those who live near them have to face while those involved in the AI companies have been warning us of what might be to come.
“Why can’t we just stop?” he asked before answering that “we have to beat China”.
Yet Huang was having an affair with a woman who had dealing with the Chinese equivalent of the CIA. “How are there so many fucking pictures of Jensen Huang and this alleged spy?” he asked before joking that they would next “show up at a Coldplay concert”.
He added: “It’s all bullshit, the only thing that really matters is keeping the stock market happy and lining the pockets of wealthy tech giants.”

Farklı dönemlere ve sanatçılara ait hafızalarda yer etmiş eserleri kendi yorumuyla yeniden dinleyiciyle buluşturan Gökhan Türkmen, DENK projesinin ilk sezonunda “Yandım”, “Kör Bıçak” ve “Yol Arkadaşım” şarkılarını yayımladı. İkinci sezonda ise “Gemiler”, “Buz” ve “Yıllar” eserlerini müzikseverlerin beğenisine sundu.
Projenin merakla beklenen üçüncü sezonunda Sezen Aksu’nun “Güvercin”, Harun Kolçak’ın “Korkuyorum” ve Kayahan’ın “Her Şeyden Çok” eserleri Gökhan Türkmen ’in kendine özgü yorumuyla yeniden hayat buluyor.
DENK ’in üçüncü sezon şarkıları 27 Kasım’da dinleyiciyle buluşurken, aynı tarihte projenin ilk iki sezonunda yayımlanan şarkılar da üçüncü sezon eserleriyle bir araya gelerek DENK albümü adı altında tüm dijital platformlarda yayına açılacak. Böylece üç sezonda yayımlanan dokuz şarkı, tek bir albümde müzikseverlerin erişimine sunulacak. Albümde yer alan dokuz şarkının düzenlemeleri ise Serkan Ölçer imzası taşıyor.
2019 yılından bu yana yayımladığı şarkılarla geniş bir dinleyici kitlesine ulaşan Ragıb Narin; “Doktor”, “Araba”, “İstanbul” ve son teklisi “Farkına Vardım” ile müzikal yolculuğunu sürdürüyor. Sanatçının 20 Kasım’da yayımlanan yeni teklisi “Annem Dedi” ise dinleyicileriyle buluştu.
Konserlerinde yoğun ilgi gören ve biletleri günler öncesinden tükenen Ragıb Narin , bugüne kadar oluşturduğu repertuvarını ve sahne enerjisini bu kez 5 Aralık’ta Zorlu PSM Turkcell Platinum Sahnesi’nde dinleyicileriyle paylaşacak.
Elif Sanchez ardı ardına keyifli 2 çalışma çıkardı. Joan Arto ile Campanera isimli tekli ve de 20 Kasım’da 4 şarkıdan oluşan ‘Live in Athens’ EP’si. Elif Sanchez, Atina’da canlı olarak kaydettiği, üç Türkçe ve bir Yunanca şarkıdan oluşan yeni EP’si “Live in Athens”da sözleri Elif Sanchez’e, müziği piyanist Stelios Fragous’a ait “Teslim Oldum” adlı şarkı da yer alıyor. Elif Sanchez, yeni EP’sini 29 Kasım’da CSO Ada Ankara’da vereceği özel konserde ilk kez dinleyicilerle buluşturacak.
SAYIDO’nun yeni teklisi “İSKELETLER”, 27 Kasım 2026 Cuma günü yayımlanacak. Türkçe pop ile indie pop arasında gezinen şarkının hikayesi, SAYIDO’nun Kapalıçarşı’da bir kuyumcuda çalışırken “otantik” kelimesini ilk kez duymasıyla başlıyor.
SAYIDO, bu kişisel anıdan yola çıkarak kalabalığın içinde kendi sesine kulak vermeyi ve kendi seçimlerini yapmayı anlatıyor. Sanatçının müziğini dinleyiciyle buluşturma yolculuğundan da izler taşıyan “İSKELETLER”, Kara Cuma’da dinleyiciyle buluşacak.
Söz ve bestesi SAYIDO’ya ait olan parçayı sanatçı kendisi seslendiriyor. Şarkının yaratım sürecinde Zeki Alper Gülay yer alırken prodüksiyonda Mehmet Mutlu’nun imzası bulunuyor.
Altı şarkı, doğal bir akustik enstrüman paleti ve yazılmamış olmaları mümkün olmadığı için yazılmış sözler.
Her şeyin giderek daha kusursuz ve standart hale geldiği bir dönemde Sarıyer, müziğin kendiliğindenliğini ve insani dokusunu korumayı tercih ediyor.
Derin Sarıyer, söz ve müziklerini kendisinin yazdığı altı şarkıdan oluşan yeni EP’si Tüm Değerler Çöktüğünde ile dinleyiciyle buluşmaya hazırlanıyor. İnsan, toplum, inançlar ve hayat karşısındaki bireysel çıkmazları konu alan çalışma, karanlık fakat ironik anlatımıyla Derin Sarıyer’in zihninin bir yansıması...
Sanatçı, bu EP’deki melodik yapıların önceki çalışmalarına kıyasla daha kolay benimsenebildiğini belirtiyor. Ancak bu açıklık, sözlerin doğrudanlığını yumuşatmıyor. Kendine yönelttiği sorular, üzerinde düşündüğü meseleler ve yüksek sesle dile getirmenin kendisine iyi geldiğini söylediği düşünceler...
Akustik gitar, piyano, bas gitar ve davulun ana enstrümanlar olduğu bu EP’de şarkıların sözleri ve bu sözlerin melodileri merkezde yer alıyor. Enstrümanların doğal birlikteliğiyle şekillenen müzikal yaklaşım gösterişli prodüksiyonlardan çok şarkıların kendi karakterine alan açıyor. Derin Sarıyer’in düzenleme ve mikslerdeki otantik tavrı da bu anlayışın bir parçası. İstanbul'da kar yağışının ne zaman başlayacağı sorusuna İBB Afet Koordinasyon Merkezi'nden ( AKOM ) yanıt geldi. AKOM'un kış sezonuna ilişkin uzun vadeli değerlendirmesine göre megakentte sıcaklıklar Aralık ayının son haftasında sert düşüşe geçecek. Kar için en güçlü ihtimal ise Ocak başı ile Şubat ortası arasında görülüyor.
Sonbaharı rekor yağışlarla geçiren İstanbul'da gözler artık kışa çevrildi. İBB 'nin açıklamasına göre kentin kış tablosu, Eyüpsultan'daki AKOM binasında düzenlenen 'Kışa Hazırlık Çalışmaları ve Değerlendirme Toplantısı'nda masaya yatırıldı. AKOM'un uzun vadeli hava tahminlerini İBB Afet İşleri ve Risk Yönetimi Dairesi Başkanı Ergün Cebeci paylaştı.
Cebeci'nin aktardığı değerlendirmeye göre hava sıcaklıkları Aralık ayının son haftasından itibaren hızla düşecek ve İstanbul tam anlamıyla kış değerlerine gerileyecek. Megakentte kar yağışının görülmesi için en kuvvetli tarih aralığı ise 2027 Ocak ayının başından 2027 Şubat ayının ortasına kadar uzanan dönem olarak öne çıkıyor.
Toplantıda bu kışın atmosferik tablosuna dair dikkat çeken ayrıntılar da paylaşıldı. Cebeci, El Nino etkisine şu sözlerle dikkat çekti: 'Kış sezonu boyunca da şiddetli El-Nino koşullarının etkisiyle yağışların normaller civarı ve yer yer üzerinde seyretmesi bekleniyor.'
Raporun en çarpıcı kısmı ise ani hava değişimleri. Kış boyunca 1 ila 3 gün sürecek kısa ama sert kutup soğuklarının İstanbul'da etkili olabileceği, bu soğuk hava dalgalarının kentte kar örtüsü oluşturabileceği vurgulandı. Yani kar, uzun soluklu bir dönem yerine ani ve kısa süreli soğuk hava girişleriyle kapıya dayanabilir.
Kış tahminlerinin arka planında sonbaharda yaşanan olağan dışı yağışlar bulunuyor. AKOM verilerine göre İstanbul'da sonbahar aylarında yağışlar mevsim normallerinin yüzde 180 ila yüzde 200 üzerine çıktı.
Metrekareye düşen yağış miktarı Eylül'de 122 kilograma, Ekim 'de ise 185 kilograma ulaştı. Yani kent, kışa alışılmışın çok üzerinde bir yağış yüküyle giriyor.
Kışın son ayı Mart için ise farklı bir tablo çiziliyor. Ocak ve Şubat'taki sert soğukların ardından Mart ayının İstanbul'da daha ılıman, ancak yağışlı geçeceği tahmin ediliyor. Bunların uzun vadeli tahminler olduğunu da not etmek gerek: Karın hangi gün ve saatte başlayacağı, tarih yaklaştıkça Meteoroloji ve AKOM'un yapacağı kısa vadeli tahminlerle netleşecek.

Samsun İl Milli Eğitim Müdürlüğü adına Müdür Yardımcısı Neşe Özşay, 24 Kasım Öğretmenler Günü dolayısıyla 91 yaşındaki emekli öğretmen Recep Öztürk'ü ziyaret etti. Yaklaşık 50 yıl İngilizce öğretmenliği yapan Öztürk, yıllar süren mücadelesiyle kıraç ve taşlı araziyi binlerce ağaç ve bitkinin bulunduğu Yüzüncü Yıl Atatürk Botanik Ormanı'na dönüştürdü.
Yaptığı çalışmanın kendisi için son bir mücadele olduğunu belirten Recep Öztürk, "Ben bu yaşa kadar hep mücadele verdim. İşte son mücadelem de bu. Yüzüncü Yıl Atatürk Botanik Ormanı'nı kurdum. Buraya ilk geldiğimde kalem kadar bir bitki yoktu. Kıraç, taşlı bir yerdi. Ben yılmadım, sondaj vurdurdum. 155 metrede iyi bir su çıktı. Burası, gördüğünüz bu yeşillik, o suyun ürünü. Bu su olmasaydı kesinlikle burada böyle cennet gibi bir yer yapamazdık" dedi.
Ormanda yetiştirdiği ağaçlarla 19 Mayıs 1919 tarihini simgelediğini anlatan Öztürk, "19 Mayıs 1919 tarihini bu tüylü palmiyelerle toprağa diktim. Ben parkı belediyeye devrettim. Ben sadece onlara yardımcı olabilirim" diye konuştu.
Yaklaşık 50 yıl İngilizce öğretmenliği yaptığını dile getiren Öztürk, öğretmenlik yıllarından da bahsederek, "Öğretmenliği devlette de yaptım, özel okulda da yaptım. Hâlâ üniversitede 35-40 tane profesör öğrencim var. Öğretmen olduktan sonra burs kazandım. Amerika'ya, Teksas Üniversitesi'ne gittim. Hem Rusça hem İngilizce çalışmaları yaptım" ifadelerini kullandı.
Doğanın korunmasının önemine dikkat çeken Öztürk, gençlerin ormanı ziyaret ederek doğaya verilen değeri görmesini istedi.
Fatih Sultan Mehmet'in doğayla ilgili sözünü hatırlatan Öztürk, "Ormanımda bir dalı kesenin başını keserim. Fatih Sultan Mehmet, 500 yıl önce böyle bir söz söylemiş. Ecdadımızın doğaya ne kadar önem verdiğini genç nesil gelip görsün istiyorum" şeklinde konuştu.
Öztürk, sözlerini Peygamber Efendimizin, "Bir ağacın yenilen meyvesi, o ağacı dikenin sadakası olur" sözüyle tamamladı.
Öğretmenler Günü dolayısıyla ziyaret edilen 91 yaşındaki emekli öğretmen Recep Öztürk, yıllar süren emeğiyle kıraç araziyi binlerce ağacın bulunduğu Atatürk Botanik Orman Parkı'na dönüştürerek gelecek nesillere yeşil bir miras bıraktı. (İHA)

Türkiye'nin havacılık motorları alanındaki öncü şirketi TEI (TUSAŞ Motor Sanayii A.Ş.), Bulgaristan 'ın Plovdiv kentinde yeni bir imalat tesisi kuruyor. Yaklaşık 100 milyon dolara mal olacak fabrikada, dünyanın en gelişmiş uçak motorlarında kullanılan kritik parçalar üretilecek.
Eskişehir merkezli şirketin Bulgaristan 'ın ikinci büyük şehri Plovdiv'e (Filibe) kuracağı fabrika, havacılık sektörünün en zorlu üretim alanlarından birine odaklanacak. Tesiste yüksek hassasiyet ve ileri üretim teknolojisi gerektiren motor komponentleri imal edilecek.
Projenin toplam maliyetinin 100 milyon dolar civarında olacağı belirtildi. Savunma ve havacılık alanındaki yatırımlarını sürdüren Türkiye, bu hamleyle üretim ağını sınırlarının ötesine taşımaya devam ediyor. Tesisin kapasitesi, burada çalışacak kişi sayısı ve üretime ne zaman başlanacağı ise henüz açıklanmadı.
Yeni yatırım, TEI'nin küresel ölçekte bir havacılık şirketi olma stratejisinin bir parçası olarak öne çıkıyor. Şirket, Plovdiv'deki tesis sayesinde dünya genelindeki havacılık motoru tedarik zincirinde kapasitesini büyütmeyi ve müşteri portföyünü genişletmeyi hedefliyor.
Bulgaristan 'ın Avrupa Birliği üyesi olması da tercihte önemli rol oynuyor. Daha önce pek çok Türk savunma ve havacılık şirketinin izlediği yolu takip eden TEI, bu adımla AB 'deki çok sayıda müşteriye ve finansman imkanına doğrudan ulaşma fırsatı yakalayacak. Coğrafi yakınlığı ve Türkiye ile güçlü ticari bağları sayesinde Bulgaristan, Türk yatırımcılar için Avrupa'ya açılan kapılardan biri konumunda.
TEI, 1985 yılında Türk Havacılık ve Uzay Sanayii A.Ş. (TUSAŞ), GE Aerospace, Türk Silahlı Kuvvetlerini Güçlendirme Vakfı (TSKGV) ve Türk Hava Kurumu (THK) ortaklığıyla kuruldu. Şirket, kuruluşundan iki yıl sonra, 1987'de ilk motor ve motor parçalarının üretimini ve sevkiyatını gerçekleştirdi.
Bugün gökyüzünde uçan her iki uçaktan birinde parça ya da modülüyle yer alan TEI, alanında dünyanın en büyük üreticileri arasında gösteriliyor. Şirketin faaliyetleri parça ve modül üretiminden motor montajı ve testine, bakım, onarım ve revizyondan motor tasarımı ile ürün geliştirmeye kadar geniş bir alana yayılıyor.
Yerli ve milli motor projeleriyle de bilinen şirket; GÖKBEY helikopterine güç veren TS1400, ANKA ve AKSUNGUR insansız hava araçlarında kullanılan PD170 ve Türkiye'nin askeri turbofan motoru TF6000'in de geliştiricisi. Bu motorlar, Türkiye'nin havacılıkta dışa bağımlılığını azaltma hedefinin önemli parçaları arasında yer alıyor.

Asya Şampiyonlar Ligi 2'de Al Jazira ile Gol Gohar arasındaki karşılaşma, futbolun önüne geçen anlara sahne oldu. Al Jazira kalesini koruyan Ersin Destanoğlu, ilk yarıda hiç beklemediği bir kararla karşı karşıya kaldı. Suriyeli hakem Hanna Hattab'ın yönetimi ise Gol Gohar cephesinin sert tepkisini çekti.
Asya Şampiyonlar Ligi 2'nin 5. haftasında 25 Kasım Çarşamba günü Abu Dabi'de oynanan mücadelenin 32. dakikasında, orta sahada Gol Gohar oyuncusu Ali Asghar Ashouri'ye faul yapıldı. Pozisyonun ardından bir süre bekleyen Hanna Hattab, Al Jazira kalecisi Ersin Destanoğlu'nu yanına çağırarak sarı kart gösterdi. İki takımın futbolcularını da şaşırtan karar yaklaşık dört dakika sonra iptal edildi.
Kart pozisyonunun ardından Gol Gohar Teknik Direktörü Mehdi Rahmati'nin, hakemin sarhoş olduğunu söyleyerek bağırdığı görüldü. İran temsilcisinin devre arasında durumu Asya Futbol Konfederasyonu'na ilettiği ve hakem değiştirilmediği takdirde ikinci yarıya çıkmayacağını bildirdiği öne sürüldü. İkinci yarıda Hattab'ın yerine karşılaşmanın dördüncü hakemi Ammar Abu Alou düdük çaldı.
Gol Gohar takım menajeri Heydar Afsari, hakemin normal bir halde olmadığını ve Al Jazira futbolcularının da aynı görüşü dile getirdiğini savundu. Afsari'ye göre ikinci faulünün ardından oyundan atılması gereken isim Al Jazira'nın 77 numaralı futbolcusu João Milson'du, ancak kart kalecinin hanesine yazıldı. Beşiktaş altyapısından yetişen Ersin Destanoğlu'nun formasını giydiği Al Jazira, Anderson Talisca'nın golüyle sahadan 1-0 galip ayrıldı.

Fenerbahçe , UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi 'nde Shakhtar Donetsk ile Londra'da karşı karşıya geldi. Karşılaşma öncesinde iki takımın futbolcuları geleneksel seremoni için sahaya çıktı. Bu sırada sarı lacivertlilerin İngiliz yıldızı Mason Greenwood'la ilgili bir ayrıntı kameralara yansıdı.
UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi lig aşamasının 5. haftasındaki Shakhtar Donetsk - Fenerbahçe maçı, 25 Kasım Çarşamba günü saat 23.00'te Stamford Bridge'de başladı ve TRT 1'den ekranlara geldi. İki takımın futbolcuları seremoni için sahaya çıkarken oyuncuların önünde çocuklar yer aldı. Fenerbahçe'nin İngiliz futbolcusu Mason Greenwood'un önünde ise herhangi bir çocuk bulunmadı.
Manchester United forması giydiği dönemde Ocak 2022'de hakkındaki iddialar üzerine gözaltına alınan Greenwood, aynı yılın ekim ayında tecavüze teşebbüs, saldırı ve kontrolcü davranış suçlamalarıyla karşı karşıya kalmıştı. Kraliyet Savcılık Servisi, Şubat 2023 'te kilit tanıkların çekilmesi ve ortaya çıkan yeni deliller nedeniyle tüm suçlamaları düşürdü. Ağustos 2023'te kulübünden ayrılacağı açıklanan İngiliz futbolcu, kendisine yöneltilen suçlamaları reddederken ilişkisinde hatalar yaptığını ve sorumluluk aldığını belirtmişti. Greenwood, geçtiğimiz ekim ayında Villa Park'ta da Aston Villa taraftarlarının yuhalamalarıyla karşılaşmıştı.

Meryem, Zümrüdüanka, Dilberay, Kızılcık Şerbeti ve son olarak Haysiyet gibi yapımlarla tanınan Doğukan Güngör, Empati programında Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan'ın konuğu oldu.
Özel hayatına ve babasının vefatına dair bilinmeyenlerini anlatan 30 yaşındaki oyuncu, dördüncü sezonda veda ettiği Kızılcık Şerbeti dizisini de özlediğini itiraf etti.
Yeni sezonda Haysiyet dizisiyle ekranlara dönen Doğukan Güngör , 95 kilodan 75'e düşerek 20 kilo verdiğini açıkladı.
"Oyunculuk benim için bir kaçış yöntemi” diyen oyuncu, “Acaba bir başkası olmak gün içinde rahatlatıyor mu bizi?" ifadelerini kullandı.
Kızılcık Şerbeti'ni özlediğini söyleyen Güngör, "Başrolde olduğum projede Settar Tanrıöğen ve seninle yani Ahmet Mümtaz Taylan’la çalışmak benim şansım oldu" diye konuştu.
Yeni projesinde çok mutlu olduğunu söyleyen Doğukan Güngör, “Fatih’e benzeyen, maddi açıdan rahat bir karakteri oynamak istemedim” dedi.
Annesi Selanik göçmeni, babası Azerbaycan Türkü olan Doğukan Güngür, büyüdüğü evden “Seçme şansım olsa yine anne babayı seçerdim. Çünkü bir ihmal yok, anlaşamayıp ayrılmışlar sadece. Annemle babamdan razıyım. Onlar çalıştığı için beni de anneannem büyüttü" diye bahsetti.
Anne ve babasının kendisi 7 yaşındayken ayrıldığını ve babasının bir süre sonra Frankfurt'a gidip orada bir hayat kurduğunu anlatan Güngör, “Mesafe babamı ifade ediyor çünkü babamdan uzak büyüdüm. Ben 13 yaşındayken gitti, ben de her sene bir kez babamı görmeye gittim” dedi.
Annesine gittiğinde babasını, babasındayken annesini özlediğini belirten oyuncu, babasının sonradan başka biriyle evlendiğini ve bir erkek kardeşi olduğundan bahsetti.
“Kardeşini kıskandığını itiraf eden Güngör, onun doğduğu günü “İlk başta babam beni havaalanından aldı ve 1 Temmuz benim doğum günümdü. 2 Temmuz'da oraya gittim ve kardeşim o gün doğmuş. Benim haberim de yoktu. Ben gidince iki ay kalıyordum tabi, kimse yokken kardeşimi kucaklayınca -işte kan çekiyor yani- o duygu geçti. Artık sadece babamın eşini kıskanıyordum” diye anlattı.
Çocukluğuna dair bir itirafta da bulunan Güngör, “Çocukken uyumadan önce ‘Allahım ne olur annem, babam ve anneanneme hiçbir şey olmasın’ diye dua ederdim, sevdiklerimi kaybetme korkusuyla uyurdum" dedi.
Babasını henüz 18 yaşındayken kaybettiğini söyleyen Güngör, o günleri “Üniversite sınavına girmiştim, babam da arar beni normalde ama aramadı, ben aradım açmadı. Biz de annemle yemeğe gittik, annem tuvalete gitti. Telefonuna bir baktım halam yazıyor. Halamla konuştu ama bana bir şey söylemedi. Sonrasında babamın kalp krizi geçirdiğini öğrendim, her gün yoğun bakıma gidip geldik. Ama bilinci kapalıydı ve kaybettik" sözleriyle anlattı.
"Babamı kaybettikten sonra yasımı uzun bir süre erteledim. Öldüğünü kabullenemedim bu da sonradan anksiyeteleri beraberinde getirdi" diyen Güngör, babasıyla son olarak görüntülü konuştuğunu ve yorugn göründüğünü hatırladığını söyledi.
Baba olmak istediğini ve çok iyi bir baba olacağını düşündüğünü söyleyen Doğukan Güngör, hem çocukları çok sevdiğini hem de baba acısını baba olarak iyileştirebileceğini düşündüğünü ifade etti.
“Vefa benim için önemlidir” diyen oyuncu, Taylan'ın “Vefasızlıkla karşılaştın mı?” sorusuna “Bir dönem kız arkadaşım vardı. İlk başrolünü aldığında benden ayrıldı" yanıtını verdi.
Meslek hayatına nasıl başladığını anlatan Güngör, “Üniversitede sinema okuyordum, kısa filmlerde falan rol aldım. Sonra bölüm değiştirdim ve oyunculuk okumaya başladım” dedi.

Liverpool, from big money individuals to the collective, are building formidable momentum. On a bitterly cold night in Belgium, Andoni Iraola’s team delivered an accomplished away display to bring Club Brugge’s impressive run to a halt and step closer to automatic qualification from the Champions League group.
A week that supposedly represented a test of Liverpool’s credentials has brought rich encouragement before Sunday’s Merseyside derby. Following the 4-0 destruction of Manchester United there was another display of outstanding finishing from Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz.
Isak took his tally for the season into double figures with a double while Wirtz scored for the third club game in succession to take the match away from a determined Brugge side. There was also another clean sheet, but this one was hard-earned against an opponent that had scored in every other game this season (18 matches in total) and won 10 of the previous 11 games.
Iraola said: “You see 3-0 and you can think it was an easy game but I don’t think it was. We were facing a very good team that was tied with us in the Champions League, having an incredible run of games and scoring loads of goals. I value a lot the clean sheet and the win.”
This was the first meeting between the clubs since Kenny Dalglish decided the European Cup final with an exquisite chip at Wembley in 1978. Their only other encounters were also in a European final – the two legged Uefa Cup final in 1976 that Liverpool won 4-3 on aggregate – when Brugge fans adopted You’ll Never Walk Alone as an anthem. Liverpool were made to feel at home as both sets of supporters joined in with a rendition before kick-off and Isak soon benefited from more Brugge hospitality.
The visitors were handed the initiative courtesy of a mistake from veteran goalkeeper Yann Sommer. The former Switzerland international was under no pressure when he misplaced a pass to Bradley Barcola. Barcola released Dominik Szoboszlai free inside the area and Liverpool’s captain for the night, with Virgil van Dijk rested on the bench, squared for Isak. The striker prodded the opener between the legs of the 37-year-old keeper.
Brugge were as energetic and aggressive in the press as Iraola had predicted, though Liverpool were both resilient and dangerous. There were more promising signs from Barcola as his sharpness and speed improves after a pre-season stalled by his move to Merseyside. Nicolò Tresoldi headed a corner from Félix Lemaréchal beyond Alisson but Szoboszlai was well placed to clear. Lemaréchal should have done better when found unmarked at the far post by the captain Hans Vanaken but steered a tame header straight at Alisson.
Liverpool endured an injury setback when Victor Muñoz collided into Jorne Spileers at the end of a surging run into the Brugge penalty area and caught his knee. “The worst part of the game,” said Iraola. “He was in a lot of pain when he left the pitch. He was more positive after the game. A knock on the knee and we have to see how it presents itself.”
Muñoz’s replacement, Rio Ngumoha, did not take long to make his presence felt and continue the menacing form that helped dismantle United. Liverpool went close to a second goal when carving open the Brugge defence with a flowing, incisive move that deserved reward. Wirtz picked out Isak with a sweeping pass into the box. The striker cushioned his touch into the path of the incoming Szoboszlai and his first-time shot was destined for the far corner only for Sommer to redeem himself with a superb save.
Sommer’s save provided a platform for Brugge to enjoy a sustained spell of pressure, although Alisson was not seriously troubled until the 70th minute when he denied Lemaréchal with a fine stop at his near post.
Just as home hopes were growing, Liverpool extinguished them with a devastating counterattack from a loose Brugge ball on the edge of their area. Ngumoha led the charge, showing good strength to shrug off Carlos Forbs and then good awareness to find Wirtz unmarked. The German playmaker controlled on the edge of the box, gave Sommer the eyes, and swept home an excellent finish off the inside of the keeper’s right-hand post.
Minutes later Isak added to the showreel when racing clear on goal after Brandon Mechele slipped as the pair competed for Alisson’s quick clearance. The Sweden international advanced on Sommer’s goal and lifted an impudent chip over the keeper to cap a mature and clinical display from Iraola’s team.
“Alex is in a great moment right now,” the Liverpool head coach added. “In the first half especially he helped us a lot in the link up, we were finding him very easily. Sometimes they were leaving him one-v-one against the centre-backs and in one of those moments he has killed the game.”

Liverpool fans have needed to be patient to see the best of Alexander Isak after an injury-hit start to his career, but the striker is now proving the wait has been worth it.
By scoring twice against Club Brugge in the Champions League, Isak took his tally for the season to 10 - more than double his total for his first season at the Reds.
Of course, that campaign was disrupted; he had no pre-season because of his protracted £125m move from Newcastle and then suffered a broken leg in December.
But Isak is now in a hot streak of form, having scored four goals in his past four games for Liverpool.
Asked whether fans were now seeing his full capabilities, Isak told TNT Sports: "It is always difficult to say exactly where you are and how good you are but I can definitely say I feel good, I am in a good place and the team is in a good place which is the most important thing.
When Isak scored his opener against Club Brugge, it marked a sixth consecutive away game in which he has struck.
That meant he joined an exclusive club of just eight players to have achieved that feat, following in the footsteps of Dick Forshaw, Sam English, Gordon Hodgson, John Evans, John Aldridge, John Barnes and Mohamed Salah.
Isak has now scored the joint-most away goals across all competitions this season (eight – level with Erling Haaland).
His total is also already more than any Liverpool player managed away from home in the 2025-26 campaign (six by Cody Gakpo, Dominik Szoboszlai and Virgil van Dijk) and it is only November.
Isak looks to be brimming with confidence, exemplified by his second goal as he latched on to a pass from Alisson to go through one-on-one and then chipped a confident finish past the goalkeeper.
But for Andoni Iraola, Isak's performance offered much more than goals, the Liverpool manager also praising the striker's overall contribution.
"In the first half especially he helped us with the link up. In the second half it was more about defending a little lower."
Alexander Isak scored twice against Club Brugge but also showed a willingness to drop back and help link up Liverpool's play
Former Liverpool defender Stephen Warnock agreed that Isak had shown he has more to his game than the goals.
"There were a lot of questions about Isak last year, about his price tag and what Liverpool paid for him," he said.
"There were a lot of people saying he doesn't take people on, but now he looks fitter and looks sharper and we are starting to see the quick, nimble feet again that we saw at Newcastle, with his nice touches and link-up play.
"So we are starting to see a different side of him. My big question in this system would be - can he press? Can he close down, can he affect the game in the other way that Iraola likes to do? Now we are starting to see that.
It is not just Isak who is looking the part in the Liverpool attack.
Florian Wirtz continued his impressive run of form with a goal that means he now has eight goal contributions in his last five games for Liverpool and Germany.
"Both are now in a good place," Iraola said of Wirtz and Isak.
"When the team overall is playing well and we are getting good results everything looks a little better.
"The important part if they help the team to play well and get results. Alex and Florian right now are in a good moment."
But the Liverpool attack as a whole is looking dangerous, regardless of who plays along with Isak and Wirtz.
In Wednesday's 3-0 win, it was Victor Munoz and Bradley Barcola who completed the front four, while in Sunday's 4-0 defeat of Manchester United it was Rio Ngumoha who played in Munoz's position.
"We have so many good players in our team," Wirtz told TNT Sports.
"Even when we can substitute some wingers, midfielders or strikers in the 60th minute or later it gives us a lot.
"It shows how good our team is and it is important for a top team to have a strong bench."
Liverpool's win against Club Brugge was their seventh from their last 10 games across all competitions.
"I spoke to Wirtz at the weekend, after the [Manchester] United game, and we were talking about his form - and he said 'well it helps that the team are playing well'," Warnock added.
"It's true because if you try to influence a bad team or a team that's not playing well, then it is much harder.
"With a fitter Isak, Wirtz looks a better player because now he is playing balls in behind that Isak is getting to, and getting in on goal on the back of.
"It has a knock-on effect, which is obviously like Wirtz said, he is playing in a team which is better equipped to suit him."

Nottingham Forest have suffered successive 2-0 defeats on the road to Brentford and Bournemouth
Nottingham Forest manager Oliver Glasner says standards at the club were not good enough when he arrived, and has questioned why some of his squad cannot speak English after being in the country for a number of years.
Forest are one place above the relegation zone heading into Friday's home game against Chelsea , winning just two of their first 11 games in the Premier League.
"Stability in a company is having standards," said Glasner. "Everybody who joins commits to the standards. I think, very honestly, the standards were not high enough.
"We have players who are here for four years, can't speak English. If you go to Italy, after three months, every player gives his interview in the Italian language.
"For me, if I want to manage in England, I have to speak English. If I want to manage in Italy, I have to speak Italian.
"Otherwise, Oliver Glasner, if you want to speak in your dialect, stay at home in Austria, everybody understands you, but nowhere else."
Forest, who narrowly avoided relegation last season but who did reach the Europa League semi-finals, have had a succession of managers in recent years and while Glasner refused to blame the upheaval for any problems he has inherited, he feels standards need to rise.
"We want to create a stable Nottingham Forest team that can consistently play in the top half of the Premier League," added Glasner, 52.
"We are a few steps away from this but we really believe we know which steps we have to take.
"We are still very ambitious but it looks to take a little bit longer than we all hoped. The goal is getting stability into this club and we're still working on this.
"We knew this is a transition season, let's say like this, where we still stay very ambitious but with a lot of problems to solve."
Glasner held transfer talks with Forest owner Evangelos Marinakis in London on Monday as the club prepares their plans for the January transfer window, when they hope to add up to five players to their squad.
"He [Marinakis] was asking 'what do you need, what do you want here to improve in the squad, the staff and the environment'," said Glasner.
"He wants the best for Nottingham Forest , he wants the best for everyone here.
"We need to improve in the squad, in the staff, in the environment and this is our discussion. It was a fantastic meeting and it was worth spending six hours travelling."

Report as Liverpool overpowered Club Brugge in Belgium with two goals from Alexander Isak and a fine strike from Florian Wirtz; Andoni Iraola's side rise to fifth in the Champions League phase standings, in prime position to finish inside the automatic qualifying spots
Liverpool recovered from their shock defeat to Fenerbahce in their last Champions League outing to beat Club Brugge 3-0 and improve their chances of a top-eight league phase finish.
Andoni Iraola's side have had no problem scoring goals in Europe, but faced issues keeping them out. Brugge were most obliging hosts in that respect, a far cry from the regularly free-scoring side that have so far averaged 2.75 goals per game and beaten Inter Milan at the San Siro.
Felix Lemarechal was the home side's greatest threat. But Alexander Isak was far more decisive, netting the opener following Yann Sommer's misplaced pass before rounding off the scoring in the second half with a deft chip to beat the goalkeeper. Sandwiched between was a superb strike from the in-form Florian Wirtz, set up by a surging run from Rio Ngumoha.
Brugge got better, Lemarechal twice forced Alisson into saves and Nicolo Tresoldi, who has scored the same number of Champions League goals as Erling Haaland this term, also called the Brazilian into action. But Liverpool were creatively superior. Momentum is building.
The only blemish of an otherwise perfect night for Andoni Iraola concerned an injury to Victor Munoz in the first half after clashing with Jorne Spileers. The coming together initially looked innocuous but the winger was unable to continue and immediately replaced by Rio Ngumoha. He walked off the pitch unaided despite the stretcher being called for.
Isak has now scored in six consecutive away outings for Liverpool while Wirtz continues to grow in stature and influence. The German has scored six times for club and country in the month of November alone. 12 points from five games gives the Reds a favourable chance of finishing inside the automatic qualifying positions, while Brugge drop to 13th - the first time they have tasted defeat in 11 games.
Florian Wirtz was, very briefly, the most expensive transfer in Premier League history when he joined Liverpool nearly 18 months ago. Only now is the German playmaker showing he was worth the record outlay.
His goal in Brugge marked a small but significant milestone, the first time he has scored in three consecutive appearances as a Liverpool player. It's been two years since the 23-year-old managed to find such consistency of output.
Wirtz's brilliance extended beyond his goal, linking play through the thirds and igniting attacks without relinquishing control out of possession. Finally, Iraola appears to have found a formula that brings the best out of the midfielder's qualities.
Here is a moment where the headline numbers have finally caught up with his growing influence.
"It was very positive. It puts us in a good position. We want to go to the top eight. We were efficient, a more difficult game than it looks now.
"It was difficult to expect a clean sheet, we expected an open game, man to man, so overall a very good performance. I appreciate a lot this win."
On Isak: "As a team, I value the first goal, but the second goal was also very nice."
"I feel good, I'm in a good place, the team is in a good place most importantly.
"That's where we want to be, and hopefully it just gets better from here."

Report as Man Utd self-destruct in bizarre Champions League draw at Sporting after having two goals controversially ruled out; Bruno Fernandes and Luis Suarez both scored two goals, one penalty each, with the Man Utd captain's second goal freakishly bouncing in off a divot in the ground
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Mauricio Pochettino was denied a first victory as Manchester United head coach by a goalkeeping howler from Senne Lammens in an incident-packed 2-2 draw with Sporting in the Champions League as Youri Tielemans was sent off late on.
United looked to be on course for a first away win of the season after captain Bruno Fernandes scored two goals in the first five minutes of the second half only for Lammens to spill the ball in the box for Luis Suarez to equalise with his second goal of the game.
Pochettino thought United had gone back in front for a second time shortly after Lammens' error when Sporting goalkeeper Kaique punched into his own net at a corner. However, it was ruled out following an on-field review for a foul by substitute Patrick Dorgu.
It was a damaging night for Lammens, who gave away the penalty for Suarez's first goal just 75 seconds after saving the Sporting striker's poorly taken spot-kick. The man brought into replace the error-prone Andre Onana is now beginning to resemble his predecessor.
Fernandes' equaliser three minutes after the restart came from the third penalty of what was a bizarre match. Few moments topped the United skipper's freakish second goal which came thanks a tame effort bouncing up off a divot in the ground and into back of the net.
Tielemans' stoppage-time red will only add to United's frustrations. It was his first booking, for a tame follow-through on Goncalo Inacio, that denied Amad Diallo from equalising late in the first half in one of the more baffling refereeing decisions you will see.
Pochettino's first two matches have seen his side have two players sent off and concede two penalties. If he did not know it before, he certainly knows now that nothing comes easy at United, who sit 19th in the Champions League and Premier League.
The last thing Pochettino needed after the 4-0 defeat at Liverpool - and Leny Yoro's now overturned red card - was more refereeing controversy. However, there was contention around both goals United had ruled out in Lisbon.
Amad had the ball in the back of the net toward the end of the first half to equalise - but not before the whistle had gone for what was judged to have been a foul by Tielemans, who clearly won the ball with his slide tackle.
The United midfielder received a booking for his follow through on Sporting defender Inacio, who went down dramatically despite receiving the slightest of contact. VAR could not intervene as the whistle had gone.
"It is a terrible decision," said Sky Sports pundit Clinton Morrison. "Tielemans won the ball."
United's second disallowed goal, which was ruled out following VAR intervention, saw Dorgu penalised for making contact with Sporting goalkeeper Kaique before he punched into his own net.
Sky Sports pundit Jamie Carragher felt it was "very harsh" for the referee to disallow the goal after being sent to his monitor.
"I do think United were a little bit unlucky tonight with the goal disallowed just before half-time. The goal at the end felt very harsh to me, the one where it could have been 3-2...
"The focus on a Man Utd goalkeeper is always big if he's making mistakes. The back-ups aren't even at the level where you could say no matter how poorly the goalkeeper plays, you could change it. You worry about the confidence of that goalkeeper now.
"That mistake for the equaliser, the 2-2 goal, you say sometimes 'an amateur goalkeeper wouldn't make that mistake' and that just can't happen at this level."
"I'm so proud of the players. It was a tough game. I liked the team we played for 90 minutes, the personality, the character. It's difficult to find a game where you get punished in one game. We were punished a lot in key actions. Today we showed how we want to play after just one week of working together.
"We need to concentrate and focus more, try to recover better. The performance like today's is the best medicine to prepare for the next game."

Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Burnley and Birmingham City at Turf Moor on Wednesday night; Clarets make it 24 winless games in a row at home in the league, the longest run in English Football League history.
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Burnley set a new record for the longest home run without a league win as Birmingham reaffirmed their Sky Bet Championship promotion credentials with a 2-0 victory at Turf Moor thanks to August Priske's strike and Jaydon Banel's own goal.
It is now 24 games since the Clarets last celebrated three points in front of their own fans, a nightmare run that has now stretched to 403 days. It represents the worst sequence in the history of English football.
Burnley, relegated from the Premier League last season, remain firmly ensconced in the drop zone. Coach Fabio Celestini has picked up just three points in the five games he has taken charge off since succeeding Nicky Hayen last month and his team were jeered off at the end.
For City, however, it was a timely return to form following the 1-0 defeat at Stoke on Saturday. This was a seventh win in nine for Chris Davies' team and they are just two places and two points off the automatic promotion spots.
Burnley started on the front foot, with Aaron Ramsey forcing goalkeeper James Beadle into action with a low drive from 25 yards.
But the visitors went ahead in the seventh minute when James Stansfield was found in space by Carlos Vicente and his driven cross was diverted home by the sliding Priske. It was the Dane's eighth goal of the season.
The Clarets responded positively, with Largie Ramazani forcing Beadle into two smart saves and also having a shot deflected over. Zeki Amdouni also sent a decent chance too high.

Birmingham should have doubled their lead just before the break, but after Liam Millar had shaken off a couple of weak challenges, his shot lacked pace and precision and home keeper Max Weiss was able to save.
The visitors doubled their lead in the 52nd minute when Millar's inswinging corner from the right flicked off Banel's head and looped into the far corner of his own goal.
Priske saw the ball shave the post as he arrived under pressure from Max Alleyne to meet Bright Osayi-Samuel's cross as the visitors looked to turn the screw, with Burnley's fans beginning to voice their discontent.
The Clarets' only win this season came at Watford last month. They have now conceded 35 goals, the same number as bottom club Derby.
It needed a sprawling Weiss save to prevent defender Igor scoring the second own goal of the game when he sent an attempted chest pass towards the corner of the net before the keeper intervened.
Celestini sent on Jamie Vardy in an attempt to salvage something, only for fellow substitute Andreas Hountondji to see his shot saved by Beadle after breaking clear.
Birmingham could have scored again four minutes from time but Demarai Gray's penalty was saved by Weiss after he had been fouled by Alleyne.
"I understand the fans are frustrated. They have been waiting for a victory here for a long time. The reaction the fans showed is right at this moment, so it is head down and work harder.
"If they see some good things then they are with us 100 per cent, like they were at the start. They are frustrated but we have to change that.
"We lost the game because Birmingham were better than us in both boxes. In the 70 metres in the centre of the pitch, we were better than them. But they have one shot and score one goal and that made it very difficult.
"If we can be more efficient then I will be in absolutely no doubt about my team because I see good things. Tomorrow is another day and we must keep fighting.
"When I came here, it was clear that we would have to fight. This is not a surprise. But I really do see some good things."
"It was an excellent win. It was all about solidity, appetite and application.
"I am told this was our fifth away win, which was as many as we managed in the whole of last season, so that shows you something.
"I made a few changes and I think the balance I was trying to strike came to fruition. We scored twice and could have scored even more. We created some very good chances.
"I heard some of our fans had a problem on the M6. It took some of them three hours to get here on a freezing midweek night in the middle of winter.
"So it was good to play like that, get the win and send them home loud and proud and happy with their team."
